text: maria-support: Hey @acme_admin — saw your escalation about repeated 500s when uploading debug bundles from your on-prem collector. Can you paste the request_id and which collector version you're running? acme_admin: request_id=rq_2026-03-17_15:22:09_7b9c, collector v1.4.2 (installed via rpm), upload hits presign endpoint then 403. We tried from bastion and got same 403. samuel-eng: thanks. two quick checks: 1) is the collector configured with the customer-supplied KMS key? 2) can you share the exact presign URL request/response (headers redacted) or curl attempt? acme_admin: we redacted creds. curl we ran: ```curl -v -X PUT "https://s3-prod.redwood.example/signed-manifest" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary @debug.bundle``` response: 403 Forbidden. presign returned 200 earlier. eli-oncall: if presign returns 200 but PUT is 403, often a mismatch in Content-Type or expected x-amz-meta headers. Also check clock skew on collector host. Can you run `date -u` and paste output? acme_admin: date shows "Wed Mar 17 15:21:40 UTC 2026". skew small. maria-support: ok. @samuel-eng can you ask for collector logs around the upload step? the collector writes upload logs to /var/log/redwood/collector/upload.log by default. samuel-eng: @acme_admin can you attach the last 200 lines from that file, and also run collector with debug to reproduce? commands: ```sudo journalctl -u redwood-collector -n 200 --no-pager``` and ```sudo /usr/bin/redwood-collector --collect --bundle-path /tmp/debug.bundle --dry-run --log-level debug``` acme_admin: attaching snippet: ```[2026-03-17T15:22:09Z] INFO presign: got url, expires_in=3600 [2026-03-17T15:22:09Z] INFO upload: initiating PUT to signed url [2026-03-17T15:22:09Z] ERROR upload: status=403, body="AccessDenied" [2026-03-17T15:22:09Z] DEBUG signer: expected_headers: Content-Type=application/octet-stream, x-amz-meta-customer=acme-corp [2026-03-17T15:22:09Z] DEBUG upload: actual_headers: Content-Type=application/octet-stream``` maria-support: interesting — signer expected x-amz-meta-customer header but actual_headers doesn't include it. That would cause S3 to reject the PUT if presign included that header in the signature. samuel-eng: yep. Two paths: 1) update collector to include meta header on PUT, 2) reissue presign without that header. Which is easier for you? acme_admin: easier to update collector. how to patch quickly? eli-oncall: quick patch: export REDWOOD_UPLOAD_META='x-amz-meta-customer:acme-corp' in /etc/default/redwood-collector and restart. Or run curl repro adding header: ```curl -v -X PUT "" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" -H "x-amz-meta-customer: acme-corp" --data-binary @debug.bundle``` try that from bastion first. acme_admin: ran curl with header manually, upload succeeded (200). so presign included that header. collector needs to add it. maria-support: good repro. Next: you'll want to regenerate a redacted debug bundle and upload. Note: for Private deployments we require redaction metadata in the manifest. If your redaction rules are out-of-date we sometimes see mismatches where collector strips a header we require. Please run: ```sudo /usr/bin/redwood-collector --collect --bundle-path /tmp/debug.bundle --redact-rules /etc/redwood/redact.yaml --include-meta x-amz-meta-customer --upload``` That will create a bundle with manifest indicating the meta header and attempt an upload. If upload fails, capture the full `upload.log`. acme_admin: running now... upload failed with 403 again. attaching new upload.log lines: ```[2026-03-17T15:31:02Z] INFO presign: url issued (expires=3600) [2026-03-17T15:31:03Z] INFO upload: PUT to signed url started [2026-03-17T15:31:03Z] ERROR upload: status=403, body="AccessDenied" [2026-03-17T15:31:03Z] DEBUG signer: presign_headers: Content-Type=application/octet-stream, x-amz-meta-customer [2026-03-17T15:31:03Z] DEBUG upload: sent_headers: Content-Type=application/octet-stream, x-amz-meta-customer: acme-corp [2026-03-17T15:31:03Z] DEBUG upload: tls_peer: CN=s3-prod.redwood.example [2026-03-17T15:31:03Z] DEBUG s3: error=Forbidden by bucket policy" ``` samuel-eng: bucket policy hint — looks like S3 bucket policy rejects uploads from that VPC endpoint or role even though presign was issued by control plane. Can you confirm the presign was created by our control plane and not by a local presign agent? acme_admin: presign comes from control plane endpoint https://control.redwood.example/api/v1/private/presign, we didn't self-presign. maria-support: OK. @eli-oncall can you inspect bucket policy for the private S3 endpoint? maybe it limits PUTs with certain user-agent or requires aws:SourceVpce. eli-oncall: I'll check. In the meantime, workaround: SFTP fallback to our offsite ingest. If presigned PUT continues to be blocked by org policy, enable legacy SFTP upload in /etc/redwood/collector.conf: ```upload_method = sftp``` and set sftp_target=upload.redwood.example:2222 and key. We keep SFTP as fallback. acme_admin: would prefer to keep S3. can you confirm what bucket condition triggered? eli-oncall: quick diff: policy had condition: "StringNotEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abcd1234"} and your host uses vpc-0abcd9999. So policy denies. That explains 403. We'll open a ticket with infra to add your VPC id or provide a regional presign relay that doesn't require SourceVpc. samuel-eng: next steps for us: 1) infra to add vpc or change policy; 2) we provide a collector hotfix toggle to avoid embedding x-amz-meta headers if policy won't allow them; 3) if you need immediate logs we can enable SFTP fallback and accept bundle manually. maria-support: I'll coordinate infra and send a secure link with instructions for SFTP fallback keys. @acme_admin do you want us to enable SFTP temporarily? acme_admin: yes please, enable SFTP so we can get a bundle up ASAP. Also we'll schedule a maintenance window to let infra change the bucket policy. maria-support: got it. enabling fallback now. debug-bot: "upload-fallback: SFTP accepted for rq_2026-03-17_15:22:09_7b9c by oncall at 15:35 UTC" :white_check_mark: samuel-eng: once you upload via SFTP, include the manifest.json from the bundle so we can validate redaction. If redaction mismatch is observed we'll iterate on redact.yaml. acme_admin: uploaded bundle over SFTP, manifest included. thank you. maria-support: received. I'll run quick verify and loop back with redaction diff and a repro patch for the collector to include meta header consistently. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
